sources.title: GTA 6 reinvigorates PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X console sales in the US, even at their inflated prices
sources.text: Despite the far higher prices of PlayStation and Xbox consoles today compared to their launch, or even the same period last year, both brands of console saw a significant boost in US sales leading up to the launch of this generation's biggest game: Grand Theft Auto 6. In the week ending 14th November, PS5 hardware unit sales registered a 2.4x increase over the same week last year. Xbox wasn't far behind, seeing a 2.3x increase in its own unit sales. That's according to industry analyst Mat Piscatella at Circana , who pulled the data from Circana's retail tracking service, which covers the US retail market. The PS5 Pro only accounted for less than 10 percent of the PlayStation's total unit sales, by the way, which Piscatella noted was "a LOT better than it has been in recent weeks", and seemingly the result of increased supply. GTA 6, of course, released on 19th November, so the surge in console hardware sales was clearly driven by the rush to attain consoles before the game came out. And while the GTA 6-driven demand isn't surprising, it's worth noting how much more expensive PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are today. A standard PS5 today costs $650, compared to $550 a year ago. The PS5 Pro saw a big jump from $750 last November to $900 today. The base Xbox Series X jumped from $650 last year to $800 today, while Series S now costs $500, up from $400. Even Switch 2, where GTA 6 is not available, saw a notable boost of 40 percent in hardware sales over the same period, driven by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the special edition Zelda Switch 2 console . Circana's November US video game market report, which releases in December, is already one of the most anticipated this year, for digesting and documenting the GTA 6 effect. Worldwide, GTA 6 sold more than 32.5m copies in one day , making Rockstar's parent company Take-Two $3.79bn (£2.89bn) in revenue. We haven't had any updated official sales figures since; but estimates suggest the sales figure could be well into the 40-millions. Perhaps Rockstar is waiting to hit the nice round 50m sales mark before announcing it. If you're playing GTA 6, you may want to keep Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough to hand. It has plenty of very helpful guides covering the game's main missions, as well as explainers for mechanics like romance and the criminal profile , and even cheats for when you finish the game.

Good luck, management does not believe in refunds.

sources.title: Chainsaws 'Would Have Been Too Much' Even for GTA 6, as Rockstar Explains Why Some Extra Violent Weapons Are Missing
sources.text: You can commit an extreme amount of violence in GTA 6 , with a wide variety of weaponry. Guns, baseball bats, even tanks can be your chosen tool of destruction. But that hasn’t stopped some from wondering where some series favourites have disappeared to. Among those are the likes of katanas and chainsaws, which were staples during Grand Theft Auto’s “3D universe” games, including Vice City and San Andreas. The chainsaw, in particular, holds a special connection to Vice City given its clear Scarface inspirations, and memorable scene involving the power tool from the 1983 movie. But despite some being spotted around the latest version of Leonida in GTA 6, neither Jason nor Lucia can wield them as weapons. Why? Well, Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson explained the decision in an interview with VGC . “As far as the chainsaw — I think it would have been too much for this game at this resolution and these characters,” Nelson says. "It’s not a resource thing. Even at the most psycho, did Jason and Lucia really need that — what’s that going to look like?” When asked specifically about why chainsaws are lying about the world, but can’t be picked up, Nelson explained that, “you’re always trying to find what is the right sort of line and the right balance; it really just depends — you want to feel like you can interact with as much of the world as possible.” I have to somewhat agree that it just wouldn’t feel like it fit either Jason or Lucia’s characters to be roaming around looking for limbs to chop off with a mechanised serrated blade. Ultimately, their story is one about committing crime to escape to a better, more “normal” life, not one about two psychopaths with a lust for blood going on a rampage. That being said, when whatever the online component of GTA 6 launches, I could see objects like this becoming weapons, allowing for people to roleplay as whatever brand of criminal, psychopath, or tree sculptor they wish. There’s a world of possibilities out there. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map . Simon Cardy is a Senior Editor at IGN who can mainly be found skulking around open world games, indulging in Korean cinema, or despairing at the state of Tottenham Hotspur and the New York Jets. Follow him on Bluesky at @cardy.bsky.social .

sources.title: GTA 6 The Missing Link Walkthrough
sources.text: How to complete The Missing Link and what to do with Monty How to complete The Missing Link in GTA 6. The Missing Link is a main story mission in GTA 6 that sees Lucia and Andrea attempt to capture a senior cartel member named Monty. In this The Missing Link walkthrough, we’ll explain how to finish the mission, how to get the unique weapon from this mission, and what you should do with Monty at the end of the mission. Over the last week we’ve published dozens of GTA 6 Guides. We’re about to enter Chapter 4 in our complete GTA 6 walkthrough. Check it our in our GTA 6 walkthrough hub.Â Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock The Missing Link, you first need to complete the Company Property mission in Chapter 3. Once it’s available, travel to Sloppy Molly’s in Watson Bay as Lucia. Make sure you’re playing as Lucia alone, as Andrea is waiting to meet her there. Head to Sloppy Molly’s and meet Andrea. After the introductory conversation, Lucia changes clothes and follows Andrea across the street into a warehouse hosting an illegal cockfight. You don’t have to take part in this thankfully, just stand around until the next part of the mission starts. Wait for Andrea to receive a message from her contact. When prompted, head to the entrance beside the bouncer wearing a white suit. Follow Andrea through the building until you reach Monty in a back room. Monty is a senior Cartel enforcer that Lucia and Andrea are targetting. Monty asks Lucia and Andrea to pose for photographs intended for the cartel’s social media accounts. Enter the back room and follow the on-screen prompts to change poses and take the required pictures. It doesn’t matter what you do in this section, as long as you take the pictures, the mission will continue. Unfortunately, the meeting soon turns violent. You’ll need to fight Monty using melee attacks until he is knocked unconscious. Once Monty is down, enemy gang members arrive and you’ll need to clear a path for Andrea. Take cover whenever possible and watch the doorways for incoming enemies. Continue fighting through the warehouse, paying particular attention to the large cockfighting room. Additional enemies arrive through the garage entrance on the right. Once the building is clear, Andrea and Lucia take Monty outside and put him in the boot of a car. Get into the vehicle and follow the GPS towards Vice City. Gang members will pursue you, but you should lose them after leaving Hamlet. Partway through the journey, you’ll be prompted to switch characters and take control of Jason. The game will now switch to Jason. As Jason, head to the front of the building and meet Lucia and Andrea. Open the boot, pull Monty out and escort him towards the backyard at gunpoint. When Raul gives the instruction, knock Monty down. You’ll then need to operate a loader to suspend Monty over an alligator-filled pool while Raul questions him. Follow Raul’s instructions carefully, raising and lowering Monty as required. Don’t lower him completely into the water, as this will kill him and prevent you from earning the Professional bonus. Once Raul has finished questioning Monty, you’ll be given the choice to put him back on dry land or drop him into the alligator pool. Both options complete the mission, so the final decision is yours. If you want to get the professional bonus for this mission, you can’t kill Monty. You can complete the mission without killing Monty, you just need to continue to interrogate him. Monty’s pistol is an optional weapon pickup during The Missing Link. After knocking out Monty and defeating the first enemy during the warehouse shootout,Â spin back toward where you came from and return to the photo room. You’ll find the pistol lying on the floor next to him. Make sure you collect it before progressing through the warehouse, as you won’t get another opportunity to pick it up during the mission. You also can’t reenter this area once the mission is finished, making this weapon missable. As mentioned the previous section, you can acquire a unique weapon during an early portion of the mission, which is the main reward. That’s everything you need to know to complete The Missing Link in GTA 6.

sources.title: Jogos Mensais PlayStation Plus de dezembro: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, Amnesia: The Bunker
sources.text: Todos disponíveis a partir de 1 de dezembro. Mande ver nos corrimãos, enfrente ícones e fuja de horrores além da compreensão com os Jogos Mensais PlayStation Plus de dezembro. Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 e Amnesia: The Bunker ficam disponíveis para todos os assinantes do PlayStation Plus* de terça-feira, 1º de dezembro, até segunda-feira, 4 de janeiro. Vamos conhecer um pouco mais sobre cada jogo. Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4 – Edição Cross-Gen | PS5, PS4 Avise a vizinhança e chame a galera do skate, porque a manobra não morreu: a clássica franquia volta com Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Tudo o que você curtia está de volta e repaginado, com mais skatistas, pistas novas, manobras mais pesadas, trilha sonora no volume máximo e muito mais. Caia nas pistas novas ou detone pelos cenários clássicos de Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 e Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 4, recriados em 4K**, com objetivos mais diretos e o clássico formato de 2 minutos. Jogue do seu jeito nos modos expandidos Criar um Skatista e Criar um Parque, agora com a opção inédita de criar objetivos personalizados para compartilhar com os amigos. Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 entrega uma experiência completa de Dragon Ball, com muita ação, batalhas intensas e diversas opções de personalização. Crie seu personagem, explore Conton City e treine com mestres icônicos da série para enfrentar inimigos poderosos e proteger o fluxo da História. Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 também traz modos multijogador online para enfrentar jogadores do mundo todo ou entrar em Batalhas de Invasão contra inimigos gigantes em equipe. Amnesia: The Bunker é um jogo de terror em primeira pessoa dos criadores de Soma e Amnesia. Sozinho em um bunker abandonado da Primeira Guerra Mundial, com apenas uma bala no tambor, você precisa encarar os horrores que espreitam no escuro. Descubra várias maneiras de sobreviver lá dentro. Na pele do soldado francês Henri Clément, você conta com um revólver, uma lanterna de dínamo barulhenta e poucos suprimentos para coletar e criar itens pelo caminho. Com elementos aleatórios e comportamento imprevisível, nenhuma partida é igual à outra. Caçado por uma ameaça constante que reage a cada passo e som, você precisa adaptar seu estilo de jogo para sobreviver a esse inferno. Cada decisão muda a forma como o jogo reage. Toda ação tem consequência. Última chance para adicionar os Jogos Mensais PlayStation Plus de novembro Assinantes PlayStation Plus têm até segunda-feira, 30 de novembro, para adicionar os Jogos Mensais de novembro à biblioteca: Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered e Monster Train 2. *A seleção PlayStation Plus pode variar de acordo com a região. Consulte PlayStation.com para mais detalhes. **A versão de PS5 roda em 4K nativo a 60 FPS no modo Fidelidade. A saída 4K exige um dispositivo ou tela compatível com 4K.

sources.text: A Sony revelou nesta quinta-feira (26) a lista de jogos mensais do PlayStation Plus para dezembro de 2026. Os assinantes do serviço poderão resgatar três novos títulos, que incluem experiências de esporte, ação e terror. Os jogos estarão disponíveis a partir da próxima terça-feira (1º) para assinantes de todos os planos do serviço: Essential, Extra e Deluxe. O prazo para adicioná-los à biblioteca termina em 4 de janeiro de 2027. A clássica franquia de skate retorna com versões recriadas dos cenários de Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 e 4, gráficos em 4K, pistas inéditas e o tradicional formato de sessões de dois minutos. O título também amplia a seleção de skatistas e os modos de personalização de personagens e pistas, permitindo que os jogadores desenvolvam objetivos personalizados e compartilhem suas criações com amigos. Baseado na franquia criada por Akira Toriyama, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 permite que os jogadores criem seus próprios personagens, explorem Conton City e treinem com figuras icônicas do anime para proteger a linha do tempo da série. Além da campanha, o título oferece modalidades multijogador online e batalhas cooperativas contra inimigos gigantes. Desenvolvido pela Frictional Games, responsável por Soma e pela franquia Amnesia, o jogo de terror em primeira pessoa acompanha Henri Clément, um soldado francês preso em um bunker abandonado durante a Primeira Guerra Mundial. Com recursos limitados, o jogador precisa administrar seus equipamentos, explorar o ambiente e adaptar suas estratégias para sobreviver a uma criatura que reage aos sons e movimentos realizados durante a partida. Os assinantes do PlayStation Plus têm até segunda-feira (30) para adicionar os jogos mensais de novembro à biblioteca. São eles: Os jogos mensais resgatados permanecem disponíveis na biblioteca dos jogadores enquanto a assinatura do PlayStation Plus estiver ativa. Amazon Prime também é feito para jogadores! sources.title: Black Friday 2026: 5 ofertas de consoles e periféricos para gamers
sources.text: A Black Friday 2026 acontece oficialmente nesta sexta-feira (27), mas diversas lojas brasileiras já começaram suas campanhas promocionais, oferecendo descontos em consoles, jogos e acessórios gamer. Para quem pretende comprar um novo videogame ou melhorar seu setup, o período pode representar uma oportunidade de economizar centenas de reais. O Olhar Digital reuniu cinco ofertas de consoles e periféricos, considerando o percentual de desconto, a economia em reais e a relevância dos produtos para o público gamer. Os preços foram levantados em 26 de novembro e estão sujeitos a alterações e à disponibilidade de estoque. O Nintendo Switch OLED possui uma tela de sete polegadas, armazenamento interno de 64 GB e permite jogar tanto no modo portátil quanto conectado à televisão. O pacote inclui Super Mario Bros. Wonder, jogo de plataforma da Nintendo que apresenta novas mecânicas e possibilidades de exploração no universo do encanador. Para quem deseja experimentar jogos em realidade virtual, o PlayStation VR2 está entre os destaques da campanha oficial de Black Friday da Sony. O dispositivo conta com telas OLED, resolução 4K HDR, rastreamento ocular e recursos de feedback sensorial que ampliam a imersão durante as partidas. O controle oficial da Microsoft é compatível com os consoles Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One e computadores, sendo uma alternativa também para quem joga no PC. O acessório possui conectividade Bluetooth, botão dedicado ao compartilhamento de conteúdo e acabamento texturizado para melhorar a aderência durante as partidas. O DualSense é o controle oficial do PlayStation 5 e possui recursos como feedback háptico e gatilhos adaptáveis, que proporcionam diferentes sensações de acordo com as ações realizadas nos jogos compatíveis. A promoção contempla modelos de cores tradicionais do acessório. O Pulse Elite é um headset sem fio desenvolvido pela Sony para proporcionar uma experiência sonora imersiva. O acessório conta com drivers magnéticos planares, tecnologia PlayStation Link e microfone retrátil com redução de ruído auxiliada por inteligência artificial. Antes de finalizar uma compra, é importante verificar o histórico de preços do produto, a reputação do vendedor, as condições de garantia e os custos de frete. Também vale conferir se o desconto depende da utilização de cupons, de pagamentos via Pix ou de outras condições específicas. Os preços apresentados nesta matéria correspondem ao levantamento realizado em 25 de novembro de 2026 e podem sofrer alterações sem aviso prévio. Amazon Prime também é feito para jogadores! sources.title: Como escolher um teclado gamer na Black Friday 2026? Saiba o que avaliar
sources.text: A Black Friday 2026 acontece nesta sexta (27) e promete boas oportunidades para quem deseja comprar um teclado gamer novo. Mas, claro, é importante conhecer as principais características dos periféricos antes de aproveitar os descontos. Entre as opções disponíveis no mercado, há modelos mecânicos, ópticos e magnéticos, cada um com tecnologias e recursos diferentes. Tamanho, tipo de switch e possibilidades de personalização também podem impactar na sua escolha. Para te ajudar nessa tarefa, o VOXL reuniu dicas com base nas recomendações da equipe especializada da Pichau. Portanto, confira o que avaliar antes de investir em um teclado gamer e conheça opções para diferentes orçamentos. A principal diferença entre os teclados está na tecnologia utilizada para registrar o pressionamento das teclas. Os modelos magnéticos, mecânicos, ópticos e de membrana funcionam de maneiras distintas, o que afeta a velocidade de resposta, a sensação durante a digitação e até as possibilidades de personalização. Nos teclados magnéticos , por exemplo, cada switch utiliza um pequeno ímã acompanhado por sensores que identificam o movimento da tecla ao longo de todo o percurso. Como o registro acontece sem contato físico entre as peças, a tecnologia reduz o desgaste e permite ajustar o ponto de atuação por meio de um software. Já os modelos mecânicos tradicionais funcionam com o contato entre componentes internos para registrar o comando em um ponto específico. Eles oferecem diferentes tipos de switches, com variações de resistência, resposta tátil e ruído, além de opções para diferentes faixas de preço. Os teclados ópticos utilizam luz infravermelha para detectar o pressionamento, também sem depender de contato físico, mas sem acompanhar o curso completo da tecla como os magnéticos. Por fim, os teclados de membrana utilizam camadas de plástico para registrar os comandos e costumam ser encontrados em modelos mais acessíveis. São alternativas comuns para tarefas básicas e uso cotidiano, mas geralmente oferecem uma resposta menos rápida em comparação com as tecnologias mecânicas, ópticas e magnéticas. Para quem joga títulos competitivos, especialmente games de tiro em primeira pessoa (FPS), recursos de desempenho podem fazer diferença. Um deles é o ponto de atuação ajustável, que permite definir a profundidade necessária para registrar cada tecla, deixando o acionamento mais sensível ou exigindo um pressionamento maior para evitar comandos acidentais. Outro recurso presente em teclados magnéticos é o Rapid Trigger. Em modelos convencionais, a tecla precisa retornar a uma altura predeterminada antes de registrar um novo comando. Com essa tecnologia, o acionamento pode acontecer assim que o usuário começa a soltar a tecla, permitindo respostas mais rápidas em movimentos repetidos. O tamanho do teclado também merece atenção. Os modelos Full Size mantêm o bloco numérico, enquanto os TKL eliminam essa parte para liberar espaço. Já os formatos 65% e 75% oferecem opções compactas que preservam as setas direcionais, enquanto as opções de 60% são ainda menores e não contam com setas ou teclas de função dedicadas — que podem ser acessadas por atalhos. Outro ponto é conferir se o teclado oferece um software para criar perfis configuráveis, que geralmente permitem alternar entre ajustes de resposta para jogos e configurações mais confortáveis para atividades de trabalho ou estudo. Antes de fechar a compra, vale considerar como o teclado será utilizado no dia a dia. Quem trabalha com planilhas, por exemplo, pode preferir um modelo com teclado numérico, enquanto jogadores que precisam de mais espaço para movimentar o mouse podem aproveitar melhor as versões TKL ou compactas. Também é importante conferir a compatibilidade do layout e dos switches com suas preferências. Felizmente, há opções para todos os gostos e diferentes faixas de preços na Black Friday da Pichau. sources.title: Como escolher um monitor gamer na Black Friday 2026? Veja dicas do que avaliar
sources.text: Falta pouco para a Black Friday 2026, que acontece nesta sexta-feira (27) e promete boas oportunidades para quem deseja comprar um monitor gamer novo. A data pode ser uma boa chance de renovar o setup e encontrar telas de qualidade por preços mais acessíveis. Antes de aproveitar as ofertas, porém, é importante conhecer algumas características técnicas dos monitores. Taxa de atualização, tempo de resposta, resolução e até o tipo de painel são alguns dos fatores que influenciam diretamente na sua experiência de uso. Para ajudar nessa escolha, o VOXL reuniu algumas dicas de ouro com base nas recomendações da equipe especializada da Pichau — uma das maiores lojas de e-commerce gamer da América Latina. Confira abaixo o que avaliar antes de investir em um novo monitor e conheça opções para diferentes faixas de preço. O tipo de painel é um dos primeiros pontos que devem ser considerados na hora de escolher um monitor gamer, já que influencia a qualidade das cores, o contraste e a velocidade de resposta da tela. Entre as opções mais comuns do mercado estão os modelos TN, IPS e VA — e cada uma dessas opções possuem suas próprias características. Os painéis TN (Twisted Nematic) costumam priorizar velocidade e custo-benefício, oferecendo tempos de resposta que podem variar de 1 ms a 2 ms. Por isso, são uma boa alternativa para quem joga títulos competitivos como Valorant e Counter-Strike 2 — embora apresentem limitações na reprodução de cores e nos ângulos de visão. Enquanto isso, os modelos IPS (In-Plane Switching) oferecem cores mais precisas e ângulos de visão amplos, sendo interessantes tanto para jogos com foco em qualidade visual quanto para atividades como edição de vídeos e design. Nesse caso, vale observar também a cobertura de cores — indicada por padrões como sRGB e DCI-P3. Já os painéis VA (Vertical Alignment) , por sua vez, se destacam pelo contraste elevado e pela reprodução de tons de preto mais profundos. A combinação faz desse tipo de monitor uma opção bastante versátil para quem joga ou assiste filmes e faz outras atividades, especialmente em ambientes com pouca iluminação. Outro cuidado importante é equilibrar a resolução do monitor com a capacidade do computador. Telas 4K oferecem imagens mais detalhadas, embora exijam mais da placa de vídeo e do processador do seu PC. Por conta disso, antes de investir em um modelo com resolução elevada, vale conferir se o restante do setup aguenta o tranco. A taxa de atualização, que é medida em Hertz (Hz), também merece uma atenção especial. Para quem busca maior fluidez em jogos competitivos, a recomendação é procurar monitores a partir de 144 Hz combinados com um tempo de resposta baixo para reduzir efeitos como o ghosting, que deixa rastros durante movimentos rápidos. Tecnologias de sincronização, como FreeSync e G-Sync, também podem fazer diferença no seu gameplay. Elas ajudam bastante a evitar a quebra de quadros, conhecida como screen tearing, ao sincronizar a taxa de atualização do monitor com a quantidade de quadros produzidos pela GPU. Por fim, não deixe a ergonomia e as conexões de lado. Recursos como Flicker Free, que reduz a cintilação da tela, e Low Blue Light, que diminui a emissão de luz azul, podem ser úteis para quem passa horas e horas na frente do computador. Além disso, para aqueles que querem economizar espaço na mesa, também vale conferir se o monitor conta com suporte ao padrão VESA — item necessário para utilizar braços articulados. Além de avaliar as especificações, é importante considerar o tamanho da tela e a distância entre o monitor e a cadeira. Um modelo maior nem sempre é a melhor escolha para qualquer bancada, especialmente quando a resolução não acompanha as dimensões do display. A equipe da Pichau também separou algumas opções de monitores gamer para diferentes orçamentos, com descontos que podem chegar a 40% durante a Black Friday. sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. sources.title: Staff at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar vote against union recognition deal
sources.text: Workers at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar Games have voted against a union recognition deal. 1,544 staff members took part in the vote across the company's locations in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee and London, representing a 93.2% turnout. Despite this huge engagement, 75.3% voted against Independent Workers of Great Britain (IWGB) union recognition, while 24.7% voted in favour. Had this vote gone the other way, IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would have been the biggest recognised union in the UK games industry, and Rockstar would have been obligated to engage with collective bargaining on pay and working hours. "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6," the company's head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, said in a statement. "This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together," said a company rep. IWGB says that Rockstar staff will keep organising regardless of whether the union is formally recognised. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for," the organisation said in its own statement. "Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us. "A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it’s one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs. "The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands." Under UK law, the union may not re-apply for recognition for three years, although staff remain free to join the RGWU. The question of forming a union at Rockstar Games followed allegations that 34 members of staff were let go from the Grand Theft Auto maker in a move that IWGB called union-busting . Rockstar parent company Take-Two has denied this claim, saying that staff were fired for "distributing and discussing confidential information". Rockstar and IWGB are currently embroiled in an employment tribunal regarding these job cuts; closing arguments were issued on November 19 . Judge Lucy Wiseman, who oversaw proceedings, said that there is no timeframe yet for the judgement, but said she would try her best to "get that judgement out as quickly as possible". Grand Theft Auto 6 launched on November 19th and made a record $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours on sale .

sources.name: GamesIndustry.biz
sources.title: Unreal Engine 6 won't include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework
sources.text: EVP of Development says Epic expects using AI will make converting projects from UE5 to UE6 more "practical and cost-efficient" Unreal Engine 6 will discontinue support for Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework, instead utilising Verse and Epic's new Scene Graph framework. In a blog post, Marcus Wassmer, EVP of Development, acknowledged this change contradicts Epic Games' June announcement that Blueprints and Actors "would coexist in UE6 Early Access and 6.0, so UE projects could upgrade incrementally while the new Scene Graph framework matures." "However, with recent advances in AI capability, we expect AI to massively help with converting UE5 projects to UE6, if not make that process fully automatic. That also means we can deliver UE6 on time (or sooner) while meeting its design goals: a new data model, a Verse-first architecture, modularity, and AI operability." Wassmer stated that Epic expects AI will make converting projects from UE5 to UE6 more "practical and cost efficient." "The cost of any given task with AI has been going down 13x year over year, and the complexity of converting a game remains more or less constant," said Wassmer. "We expect this trend to continue and to accelerate, which should result in modest conversion costs by the time UE 6.0 is out in the world." "Fortnite has one of the largest libraries of Blueprints anywhere. Two weeks ago, we experimented with using AI to convert all of the Blueprints for Battle Royale to Verse. This project was expected to take years, but we now have a working prototype of Fortnite that is about 3 million lines of Verse code after porting more than 20,000 Blueprints. Wassmer concluded: "The team is hard at work iterating to validate the resulting performance, memory usage, and architecture. We’re doing this at scale now, and this conversion will help make the process as easy as possible for everyone else." The latest build of Unreal Engine is scheduled for 2027 and recently entered preview ahead of the Epic AI MegaJam. UE 5.9 will introduce several UE6 AI tools, including expanded Python scripting, Model Context Protocol (MCP) improvements, browser deployment capabilities, and the shared workspace Unreal Canvas .

sources.title: GTA 6 launch drives combined 2.3m downloads of franchise's mobile ports, according to AppMagic
sources.text: GTA: Vice City – Definitive Edition had the most installs at over 1.1 million The record-breaking launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 drove a combined 2.3 million downloads of the franchise's mobile ports in its first week. According to data from AppMagic (via PocketGamer ), downloads increased from 590,000 to 2.3 million between November 16 and November 22. GTA: Vice City – Definitive Edition was the top installed game during this period, with over 1.1 million installs. The peak for GTA mobile port downloads occurred in December 2023 after the GTA Trilogy launched on Netflix, reaching eight million downloads between December 11 and December 17. AppMagic also estimated GTA 6's impact on other games in the franchise on Steam. Daily active users for GTA 5 – Enhanced Edition rose from 407,000 to 718,000 between November 16 and November 21. DAUs playing GTA Legacy increased from 293,000 to 494,000. GTA 4: The Complete Edition grew from 68,000 to 115,000, the largest increase for a GTA title on Steam since AppMagic began tracking data in 2024. Other apps benefited from GTA 6's launch as well. The PlayStation App reached 1.3 million downloads, more than double the previous week and triple its typical level. PS Remote Play, the Xbox app, and Twitch also saw increases, with Twitch installs doubling to 1.3 million during launch week. GTA 6 marked the largest launch in PlayStation history , attracting over 39 million unique players and logging 683 million hours of gameplay. The average playtime per player was 17.4 hours. New console usage also spiked, with GTA 6 as the first game played on 70% of new PlayStation 5 consoles. Sony reported that GTA 6's launch day saw the highest number of connected consoles in a single day, excluding the console's launch and holiday periods. Rockstar previously announced that GTA 6 pre-orders reached 32.5 million units, generating $3.79 billion in first-day sales revenue.

stories.title: The Fable reboot had to look beyond Lionhead's RPG trilogy because games like The Witcher 3 "became the gold standard"
stories.summary: Developer Playground Games had to look beyond Lionhead's original run of Fable games when rebooting the classic fantasy series, and it's all thanks to games like The Witcher 3 , which changed what many players expect from their big RPGs and set a new "gold standard." Read more

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: The Fable reboot had to look beyond Lionhead's RPG trilogy because games like The Witcher 3 "became the gold standard"
sources.text: Developer Playground Games had to look beyond Lionhead's original run of Fable games when rebooting the classic fantasy series, and it's all thanks to games like The Witcher 3 , which changed what many players expect from their big RPGs and set a new "gold standard." The upcoming Fable reboot is finally ending its decade-long development journey soon. Playground Games had to set up an entirely new team to work on its fairytale revival, so Fable's production wasn't quite as smooth sailing as the studio's consistently excellent Forza Horizon series, for example. Asked about what's changed during that time, in an interview with GamesIndustry.biz , studio founder and general manager Ralph Fulton named technological advancements as a biggie, but the impact of other games was perhaps even greater. "In 2015, The Witcher 3 redefined what an open-world action RPG looks like and became the gold standard," Fulton said. "And after that bar was raised, the Assassin's Creed franchise changed into this more modern iteration with Origins, Odyssey, and Valhalla, and became like a quasi-RPG." "All of these games continue to reset player expectations," he continued. Millions of players suddenly had certain expectations about what their big-budget, open-world role-playing games should look like. So, Playground couldn't pull inspiration from Fable and Fable alone. "I think looking only to the original Fable trilogy for inspiration would leave us lacking in terms of what the modern audience, the modern marketplace, expects," Fulton added. Still, Playground's Fable is drawing most heavily from Lionhead's Fable. Fulton specifically mentions the game's signature British wit and in-flux morality system as examples. Then there's also the spontaneous life sim elements that "none of our competitors do," according to Fulton. "It's a totally Fable thing, the social simulation and economic simulation. Okay, there are games that have economic simulations, but they're not in [our] RPG category. Fable is unique in that it's almost like a life sim in terms of genre." Raising four separate families and becoming the entire map's benevolent landlord was one of the funnest parts of Fable back in the day, alongside those sometimes silly characters. Seeing next year's Fable lean into those systemic choices, and having Albion's NPCs react to them more believably, could give this one a very long shelf life.
